doubleHornHonk.name: Double Horn Honk Removal
doubleHornHonk.desc: Removes the double horn honk when closing doors while the vehicle is running with key fob outside.

laneChangeAssist.name: Lane Change Assist (IPMA) Enable
laneChangeAssist.desc: Enables MFCLKS LKAlert+LKAid+LCWA lane change assist features in IPMA module.

inLaneRepositioning.name: In-Lane Repositioning (FeatureCfg IACCMode) Enable
inLaneRepositioning.desc: Repositions truck away from adjacent semi trucks within the lane (FCIACCM Preview+CurveControl).

laneBiasingPredictiveSpeed.name: APIM Lane Biasing & Predictive Speed Assist
laneBiasingPredictiveSpeed.desc: Enables Lane Biasing and Predictive Speed Assist under Cruise Control in Sync APIM.

apimLaneChangeAssist.name: APIM Lane Change Assist
apimLaneChangeAssist.desc: Enables Lane Change Assist under Cruise Control in Sync APIM.

ipmaCustomerSettingAlbAlc.name: IPMA Customer Setting ALB & ALC Vehicle Selection

bambiMode.name: Bambi Mode (Fog + High Beams)
bambiMode.desc: Keeps front fog lights illuminated when high beams are engaged.

turnSignalTap5.name: Lane Change Tap Count (5 Flashes)
turnSignalTap5.desc: Increases soft-tap turn signal blink count from 3 to 5 flashes.

secureIdle.name: Secure / Police Idle
secureIdle.desc: Prevents shifting out of Park if key fob is missing from running vehicle.

globalWindows.name: Global Window Open / Close
globalWindows.desc: Opens/closes front windows by holding lock/unlock buttons on key fob.

beltminderChime.name: Beltminder Audio Chime Removal
beltminderChime.desc: Removes seatbelt warning audio chime for front seats.

fakeEngineSound.name: Fake Engine Sound (ANC/ESE) Removal
fakeEngineSound.desc: Removes simulated engine sound synthesized through cabin speakers.

offroadScreen.name: Off-Road & Pitch/Roll Screen Enable
offroadScreen.desc: Displays 4x4 off-road status, pitch, roll, and steering angle gauges on Sync 4 screen.

appSettings.telemetryRateDesc: Adjust how frequently live vehicle telemetry PIDs are polled
